row: Welcome to TopShelfKids where we upload fun picture book read alouds twice a week. We enjoy books and would love to share our joy of reading with you. We hope our stories inspire you to become future leaders and innovators! Please don't forget to like and subscribe. We are so glad you stopped by!!!
